title: Structured vs Todoist: Which Planner Is Right for You?
caption: Video: Structured vs Todoist in five rounds, plus a bonus round (2:45)
description: Structured or Todoist? Structured if you lose track of time and need to see your day as blocks, Todoist if tasks slip out of your head and you juggle lots of projects. Five rounds: seeing your time, getting tasks out of your head, big projects, staying focused, and devices.
chapters: Round 2: Getting tasks out of your head
Bonus round: the moment you freeze
FOCO, for when you can't begin
